tasks.title: Audit generators for destructive whole-file writes
tasks.prompt:
Audit the generator scripts in scripts/ (files matching generate-*.mjs and any *inject*.mjs) for the destructive-write pattern: a script that rewrites a whole output file when it only owns a few fields or regions of that file, and so silently drops content another generator or a human previously wrote there.

For each generator, determine: (a) which output paths it writes, (b) whether it writes whole-file (fs.writeFile of a freshly built string) or merges into existing content, and (c) whether any OTHER generator or hand-authored layer also writes the same path. A whole-file write to a path that something else also contributes to is the finding worth reporting.

Write your findings to reports/generator-write-safety.md as a markdown table sorted with the highest-risk generators first, with columns: Generator | Output path(s) | Write mode | Also written by | Risk | Evidence (file:line). Under the table, add a short 'How to confirm' section naming the exact greps or commands a human would run to verify each high-risk row.

Report only what the code actually shows. If you cannot establish a claim from the source, say so in the row rather than inferring it. Do not rank anything as high risk without a file:line citation.

Write exactly one file: reports/generator-write-safety.md. Change no other file.
